# bioexcel/biobb_mem/fatslim_apl

## Summary

Wrapper of the FATSLiM area per lipid module for area per lipid calculation.

FATSLiM is designed to provide efficient and robust analysis of physical parameters from MD trajectories, with a focus on processing large trajectory files quickly.

Nextflow adapter of the [FatslimAPL](https://biobb-mem.readthedocs.io/en/latest/fatslim.html#module-fatslim.fatslim_apl) building block of [biobb_mem](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_mem) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_MEM_FATSLIM_APL } from 'bioexcel/biobb_mem/fatslim_apl'

workflow {
    BIOBB_MEM_FATSLIM_APL(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_top_path` | yes | tpr, gro, g96, pdb, brk, ent | Path to the input topology file |
| `input_traj_path` | no | xtc, trr, cpt, gro, g96, pdb, tng | Path to the GROMACS trajectory file |
| `input_ndx_path` | no | ndx | Path to the input index NDX file for lipid headgroups and the interacting group |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_csv_path` | yes | csv | Path to the output CSV file |
| `versions_biobb_mem` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_mem', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of FatslimAPL properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_csv_path: 'csv']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_mem container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_MEM_FATSLIM_APL' {
        ext.properties = [lipid_selection: 'not protein and element P']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lipid_selection` | string | "not protein and element P" | Headgroups MDAnalysis selection. |
| `protein_selection` | string | "protein and not element H" | Protein selection interacting with the membrane. |
| `cutoff` | number | 3.0 | This option allows user to specify the cutoff distance (in nm) to be used when performing the neighbor search needed by the APL calculation algorithm |
| `limit` | number | 10.0 | This option allows user to specify the upper limit (in nm2) for a valid area per lipid value. |
| `begin_frame` | integer | -1 | First frame index to be used for analysis. |
| `end_frame` | integer | -1 | Last frame index to be used for analysis. |
| `ignore_no_box` | boolean | false | Ignore the absence of box information in the topology. If the topology does not contain box information, the box will be set to the minimum and maximum positions of the atoms. |
| `return_hydrogen` | boolean | false | Include hydrogen atoms in the output index file. |
| `binary_path` | string | "fatslim" | Path to the fatslim executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
